name: Private owner state and explicit scoped execution
statement: Public diagnostics cannot reveal mutable journals, collectors, credential-bearing adapters or runtime references. Sessions intersect operation and location grants with canonical authorization; job IDs and idempotency do not bypass revocation. Evidence must satisfy its published versioned schema. Preserve independent byte verification, uncertain outcomes, original failures and R2 destructive-operation gates.

org.redown.status: Partial implementation; promotion blocked pending full certification and fresh browser/live verification
